key_decisions.decision: Keeps Solomon’s self-description and leadership idiom rather than assigning an age.
Retains the listening-heart image at the center of wisdom.
Keeps the death’s explanation inside the woman’s testimony.
Clarifies the pronoun’s referent from the contrasted pleas.
